description.en:
Twenty-year-old Jeong Seyun, a rabbit descendant, knows that dragons are considered the chaebols of the beast world. But she'd rather have a relationship based on love than an arranged marriage with a dragon. And as fate would have it, as soon as she enters college, she falls in love with fox descendant Kim Hangyeol at first sight! She musters up the courage to confess, but... to the wrong person?!
Will Seyun's dream of a romance come true? (Summary adapted from Kakaopage.)

In a world where monster hunters are hailed as heroes, Cheon Haesun has been treated like an outcast because of his abnormal looks. As if that wasn't bad enough, a pack of monsters attacks his neighborhood on the day he discovers he's dying from an unknown illness!

With his sister's sacrifice, Haesun survives and somehow awakens to become a Poisoner, a rare hunter with toxic healing abilities.

But will his poisonous powers cure Haesun's illness and guarantee a normal life he's always dreamed of?

description.en:
She possessed the mistress of the male lead in an R19 novel. In the original novel, the male lead was trash who abandoned her after getting her pregnant, saying that he belatedly realized that he loved the heroine. Fortunately, it was still before the original work started. She decided to scrap that shit herself.

"No, I don't want to," she flatly rejected Killian's offer to have an affair with him.

When he asked her why, she smiled brightly and answered, "Young Master is not my taste. If I must say, your younger brother is much preferable.”

"What? You prefer my younger brother?"

*Yeah. Not you, but your brother.*

Unlike the original, she firmly set up an iron wall, took care of Lexion, the younger brother who was abused by his elder brother, and protected the original female lead who had low-esteem from that shitty male lead.

And now that she'd already done what she had to do, she's off to go.

But a few years later–

Lexion, who had pushed out his older brother and taken the ducal title, came back to her as a beast with a decadent beauty. On top of that, he was even holding the engagement document that she had signed as a joke during their childhood.

"I've never forgotten you for a moment. Please marry me, Noona."

*No, wasn't that just for playing house?*

Every time she refuses his marriage proposal, he gently hugs her around the waist, and asks in a cold voice, "Did your taste change while I was away?"

Lexion's eyes were full of life as he asked.

It was as if when he found out who her type was, he'd kill them right away.

Em thích em trai của ta?” Chính xác rồi đó anh trai. Không phải anh, mà là em trai của anh cơ. *** Không như nguyên tác, tôi đã xây dựng một bức tường thành chắc chắn nhằm ngăn chặn tên thiếu gia kia. Não, isso não era para uma brincadeira de criança? "Você mudou seus gostos enquanto eu estava fora?" Os olhos de Lexion estavam cheios de emoção quando ele perguntou. description.en:
As the hero's comrade, I died after blocking him from the evil dragon's breath. Well, it's fine. The Hero Elkinas was the only friend I trusted to have my back. I'll go out with a bang, I guess, so the hero can marry a pretty woman and live the rest of his life.

…Is what I thought would happen, but after 80 years passed, I came back to life in a completely different body. And…

“It’s regrettable, Arlene. Elkinas went insane. Completely insane.”

That was the first thing I heard.

What else could I do? I should help him. To help my close friend who seems to have not been able to accept my death, I decided to stay by his side while hiding my identity. This way Elkinas could completely accept the past and become happy, since this is the very reason why I died for him. But… I think he recognized me.

"You're… Arlene, aren't you?"

I touched my face. I definitely don't look like Arlene. Shouldn't there be no way he could know who I was?

"I won't ever let you go… Ever," Elkinas said with shining eyes.

---

Hee-na Lee, eine gewöhnliche Büroangestellte, hatte mit all dem nichts zu tun, bis sie selbst eines Tages plötzlich 'erwachte' und in ein Dungeon hineingesogen wurde. Dort begegnete sie Jin-hyeon Kang, dem berühmtesten Hunter Koreas. Entgegen ihrer Hoffnungen gehört Hee-na selbst nicht zur Kriegerklasse, sondern zur bisher verborgenen Klasse 'Haushälterin'. Was sollte sie denn damit anfangen?
description.en: Tired, overworked Huina thinks dungeons and Hunters have nothing to do with her until she's suddenly gifted with a Hunter's abilities. Now she has to navigate her game-like reality with the skills and stats of... a Homemaker?! With this class, Huina becomes the ultimate cook, custodian, and caretaker, which lands her a seemingly harmless job in a Hunter guild. But will this organization help Huina bring the Hunters a revolution of rest or force her into dangers she'd never dreamed of?

대한민국 대표 얼굴 맛집의 귀환! 이번엔 손맛으로 세상을 구원하리라!
대한민국의 평범한 직장인 이희나. 25세.
오늘도 평범하게 야근 삼매경... 인 줄 알았는데.
갑자기 각성했다.
그리고 갑자기 던전에 떨어졌다.

"하느님부처님알라신님! 제발 헌터, 전투계로 각성하게 해주세요!
이왕이면 쎈 걸로!!"

간절한 바람에 시스템이 응답했다.

[축하합니다!]
[히든 클래스 '살림꾼'(D)으로 각성했습니다!]

희나의 스킬은 나물 뜯기(C), 해충 박멸(D), 이 맛이 바로 손맛(D)
실생활엔 매우 유용하지만, 과연 이걸로 살아남을 수 있는 거야?!

하지만 웬걸?
대한민국 랭킹 1위, S급 헌터 강진현이 플러팅을 시전한다.

"저의 모든 것을 당신께 맡기겠습니다."
"강진현 헌터님..."
"네. 저를 책임져주시겠습니까?"
"가사도우미가 되어달라는 말을 왜 그렇게 이상하게 하세요!"

소소하고 평범하게 사는 게 꿈이었던 희나의 일상은 괜찮은 것인가?!
말하는 달팽이, 움직이는 반려식물과 함께하는♥
유쾌한 로맨스판타지 <던전 안의 살림꾼>!
description.ru:
Возвращение представляющего Корею лучшего источника красивых лиц! В этот раз мир будет спасен мастерством рук!
Обычный корейский офисный работник Ли Хина. 25 лет. Сегодня как обычно поглощена сверхурочной работой… Но вдруг она пробудилась и резко провалилась в подземелье.
«Прошу, господьбуддааллах! Прошу-прошу, благословите меня боевым классом! И лучше посильнее!»
На искреннюю просьбу откликнулась система.
[Поздравляем! Вы пробудились как скрытый класс «экономка» (D)]
Навыки Хины – выдирание травы (С), истребление паразитов (D), этот вкус – мастерство рук (D), очень полезны для жизни, но сможет ли она выжить с их помощью?!
И что это такое? Первый в ранге S в Корее, охотник Кан Джинхён флиртует.
«Я доверю вам все, что у меня есть.»
«Господин Кан Джинхён…»
«Да. Вы возьмете на себя ответственность за меня?»
«Почему просьбу стать вашей экономкой вы преподносите так странно?»
Все ли будет в порядке с повседневной жизнью Хины, которая мечтала жить обычной жизнью?! Вместе с говорящей улиткой и движущимся домашним растением, представляем приятное романтическое фэнтези «Экономка в подземелье»!

Lee Heena, uma trabalhadora de escritório sul-coreana comum, de 25 anos.
Hoje, mais um dia comum completamente perdida nas horas extras... foi o que ela achou. E então, de repente, caiu em uma masmorra.

“Deus, Buda, Alá! Por favor, deixe-me despertar como um caçador do tipo lutador! Se possível, um forte!!
Do desejo desesperado, o sistema respondeu.

[Parabéns!]
[Você despertou como uma classe oculta, 'Empregada Doméstica'(D)!]

Embora as habilidades de Heena em Colheita de Ervas(C), Exterminar Pragas(D), Este é o Gosto do meu Toque Mágico(D) sejam muito útil na vida diária, ela conseguirá sobreviver com essas habilidades?!

Mas, o que é isso?

“Vou dar o meu todo para você.”
“Caçador Kang Jinhyeon…”
“Sim. Você assumirá essa responsabilidade por mim?
“Por que você me pede para ser sua empregada doméstica de um jeito tão estranho?!”

A vida cotidiana simples e comum com a qual Heena sonhou está bem?! Com um caracol falante e plantas de estimação em movimento ♥

Monk Sanzang from the "Journey to the west" has time slipped to the present-day Korea.   
  
She has lived her lifetime constantly fighting yokai but her most dangerous opponent turns out to be just one guy?!  
  
On the orders of Buddha, Monk Sanzang and her companions pilgramaged the Western regions in search of his teachings.  
Unlike Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Wujing, who hoped to become gods in recognition of their contribution, rather than being tied down to the life of Buddhism, Sanzang wanted to remain in the human world and enjoy a new life as an ordinary human.  
  
But as she was being dragged to Heaven by orders from the Buddha, she notices a strange tunnel leading to the human world in which she escapes into…  
  
And the place where she fell is the Republic of Korea's Jeju Island!  
And she meets a guy named Lee Hyun?!  
  
The time-slipped Monk Sanzang a.k.a Hyeonjeong and the tsundere Lee Hyun's turbulent romance!

Vì gần giống với Thánh nữ mà chịu nhiều đau khổ, đã là rất bất công rồi, nhưng sao nhân vật phản diện lại xuống tay với mình không một chút thương sót chứ?

Không, thật ra, ở trong sách, mình sẽ chết như vậy.

“Cuộc đời mình bị huỷ hoại cả rồi. Sau tất cả, sao mình lại phải chịu một cái chết lố bịch như vậy chứ?”

Mình vẫn còn cơ hội! Mình vẫn chưa chạm mặt bất kì nhân vật nào nên mình sẽ bỏ chạy!

Nhưng sao nhân vật phản diện lại đổ gục trước mắt mình…?

Mình đã rất cố gắng để cứu sống nhân vật phản diện đang cận kề cái chết.

Nhưng anh ta nói muốn nhận mình làm con gái và nuôi dạy mình trở thành Thánh nữ?!

Và như thế, mình đồng ý trở thành con gái của anh ta vài ngày trước khi lẳng lặng rời đi.

“Con gái ta là thiên tài. Không có đứa trẻ nào trên thế giới này hơn được con gái ta đâu.”…Mình nghĩ mình nịnh cha rất tốt đó.

Ngay cả những người lúc đầu đi theo vị Thánh nữ thật cũng bắt đầu để ý đến mình.

Chuyện gì đây? Chẳng phải họ ghét mình á?

The Chronicles of the Seven-Colored World  a series that ran for over 800 episodes and earned its fair share of curses from readers. A batshit crazy world full of absurd plot twists, endlessly evolving monsters, and heroines who try to kill the protagonist at every turn.

"And I got reincarnated into this mess?"

I’ve ended up as a nobody named Rudian — a total background character.

But with a freaky eyeball monster I happened to pick up, Adi, and a demonic sword called Diablo by my side, I’ve decided to take over this insane world.

Time to dive into some true chaotic gameplay!

May my comfort reach you!  
  
A fantasy romance to heal your heart.

Beings from a different dimension have started a war with mankind. To counter this threat, an academy called "Genetics" that trains female warriors called "Pandora," who can wield special weaponry and armor, was formed. Kazuya Aoi decided to enroll in this school because of a promise with his sister, an outstanding alumnus who died in battle. There he meets second year Satellizer L. Bridgette, nicknamed "The Untouchable Queen" due to her solitary demeanor but also top of her class whose battle simulation streak is undefeated, until he came… and slowly changed her.

description.en:
He became the Emperor when he was just a boy and was beheaded before reaching adulthood. It was a tragedy brought about by his fate as the first noble wizard.

“Ian, don’t be born in your next life.”

He thought everything was over, listening to the traitor’s heartless words. He knew, but…

“You are a symbol of peace. Where else would you find such honor as a lowly one?”

He became the Margrave’s bastard son, whose family went extinct 100 years ago.
A lowly, unsophisticated one, destined to be sold as a hostage to the barbarians across the border.
___
Betrayed and on the brink of death, Ian Verocian, a mage and the emperor of the Variel Empire, is sent a hundred years back in time by a forbidden spell. He wakes up as Ian Vratz, a margrave's illegitimate son, and soon learns he's about to be sent off to a desert tribe as part of a political treaty. Now, Ian must use his wits and powerful magic to gather allies and figure out the plots lurking around him. The question is... can this young mage change his fate before time runs out once more?

Lilliana is a neglected princess with a single mission: do not get pregnant. Ever since she woke up in a novel where she will die giving birth to the main character, Lilliana has known that her pregnancy will be her death sentence. However, her mission’s greatest obstacle is her new husband, Emperor Helio. Although they have married for political reasons, the ruthless emperor's fondness for Lilliana drives him to decide that his mission is to win her over. description.en:
Imagine being kin to your sworn enemy.

Killed in battle while defending his country, Bern wakes up in the body of the enemy prince, Kalian, and vows to avenge his people. But between taming an abusive half-brother and surviving his mother's deadly web of intrigue, sweet revenge seems to slip further beyond his grasp at every turn.

---
I could hear the hum of life in my ears. It was hard to breathe… I raised my gaze and stared into the distance. However, my blurred vision could not see anything. The light began to fade. That was my last memory.

When I opened my eyes once again, it was ten years before that last memory took place. And of all the things I could have become, it was from the enemy country that drove Secretia to ruin – I had become Kyris' third prince, Calian.

…..

Bern was the proud Crown Prince of Secretia who fought and died in the war against Kyris. But he woke up ten years into the past – as the timid Third Prince of Kyris, Calian.

"T-t-take responsibility, or d-don't touch me!"

I just felt relieved, thinking there wouldn't be any romantic feelings or involvement between me and the male lead.

"One year later. P-please meet me... on the day I get out of here!"

Meeting him didn't seem too difficult, so I agreed. So I was released first, but...

**

”Come on in. My lovely little sister who's as charming as the flower."

On the day I was released, the man who approached me turned out to be my brother.
I was the villain's sister.

"You went through a lot on my behalf, didn't you? I've been waiting for you."

…Fuck. On top of it all, I’m the precious little sister of the villain who is the male lead’s nemesis?

**

Three years later, when we met again, the male lead smiled with a completely different face.

"Hello, Iyana. I'm going to kidnap you from now on."

description.en:
Everyone knows Duke Windzorice is a cold, powerful man, but for the young saint Lilliette, he's a kind adult and just the person to save her from the Temple's abuse! After healing his eyes, Lilliette is granted a home at Windzorice Castle, but the Temple's not willing to let her go. That's when the duke comes up with a foolproof plan to keep her by his side... They'll say she's his daughter! Can this fake family vanquish the Temple and live in peace? Or will the little saint suffer once more?
___
Born Again to Escape, and to Heal a Broken Heart.

Liriette, blessed with divine power that could heal others through her blood, had spent her short life as nothing more than a tool for a cruel High Priest. Her end came quietly, used and discarded. But one day, she opened her eyes… and she was 10 years old again.

"This time, I will never let the horrors of my past repeat themselves."

Determined to escape the clutches of the High Priest, Liriette sought refuge in the farthest corner of the empire, with none other than Duke Windsorice, the ruler of the cold and mysterious North.

"I can heal your eyes. Please, let me stay by your side."

At first, it was simply a desperate attempt to escape her dreadful fate. Yet, as time passed, her hopes and dreams began to grow beyond mere survival.

"Would you… become my daughter?"

With trembling hands and a soft voice, Liriette asked, "What would you gain from me as your daughter?"

The Duke's lips curled into the faintest smile, "A kind and beautiful daughter."

Follow the heartwarming journey of a lonely girl who finds her home and happiness as the beloved daughter of the empire’s coldest Duke. Watch as the once-unfeeling ruler becomes the ultimate doting father, melting the icy North with his newfound love.

description.en:
Until recently, I had three wishes that I could only hope to come true.

 

‘Please let my missing oldest brother come back.’
‘Please let my Second Brother awaken so he could stop working as a rift porter.’
‘And my youngest brother…As long as he can open his eyes…’

 

There’s nothing I wanted but happiness… was what I thought…!

 

“Keuhk…I’ll only play for 10 years so I can keep the darkness inside me, so work a little harder, youngest!”
My oldest brother spoke as though he were still in his adolescence.

 

“Since hyung is playing for 10 years, I’ll also play for 10 years, too!”
My second brother who returned as an awakener from the future (as he claims to be) said.

 

“You foolish pig, I’ll give you an opportunity to serve this noble soul.”
My Third brother… let’s just move on since it makes my head ache just by thinking about him.

 

“You unemployed parasites! Why can’t you all go out and find jobs?!”

 

Can the future of Lee Bobae, a girl with nothing more to wish for, be full of happiness?

description.en:
There was nothing left for me in this life, so I ended it all... only to awaken in the body of a novel's villainess! Ariadelynn was madly in love with the supporting lead, Karlotian, but he loved another. Driven mad by jealousy, she used dark magic to attack her rival, but failed. Now Ariadelynn is an eternal outcast, hated by all--which is fine by me! I won't be her for long. In fact, I know the perfect way out of this dreadful life!
___
Tsukishiro Yuina, a singer who lost her voice in a traffic accident, felt hopeless. In her despair, Yuina chose to end her life, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself in the world of a novel she had read before her death, *The Saint Who Abandons Her Status*.

She had possessed the body of the novel's villainess, Ariadeline. To make matters worse, it was at the point where the main protagonists were already married, and Ariadeline had been condemned.

Even in the world of the novel, her miserable situation didn't improve. Yuina (now Ariadeline) decided to take her own life again, but this time she was stopped by her former husband, Carlothian.

"I don't want you to die."

Even though he was the one who killed her in the original story, Carlothian repeatedly interfered with Ariadeline's attempts to end her life.

"Why won't you kill me like you did in the original story...?"

Thus begins the tale of the villainess who lost her dream, Ariadeline, and her tsundere former husband, Carlothian, as they attempt to redo their misunderstood love story.

description.ru:
Цукисиро Юна — талантливая певица, потерявшая голос в результате автомобильной аварии. В отчаянии она решается покончить с жизнью, но, очнувшись, обнаруживает себя в мире романа «Святая, отказавшаяся от своего положения», который читала перед смертью. Юна оказывается в теле злодейки Ариаделины в тот самый момент, когда история уже закончилась, а Ариаделина была осуждена.
Даже в новом мире её жалкое положение не изменилось, и Юна (теперь Ариаделина) снова пытается покончить с собой. Но её останавливает бывший муж Карлотиан.
«Я не могу позволить тебе умереть.»
Хотя именно он убил Ариаделину в романе, Карлотиан продолжает мешать её попыткам свести счёты с жизнью. Почему он не убивает её, как должен был?..
Это история любви, недопониманий и второго шанса между Ариаделиной, злодейкой, потерявшей свои мечты, и её бывшим мужем-цундэрэ Карлотианом.

Es gibt nur einen Haken: in ihrem Keller tauchen Dämonen auf und als wäre das nicht genug, erscheinen ständig ungebetene Gäste in ihrem Haus, allem voran der mysteriöse Großherzog des Landes, gefolgt von kaiserlichen Rittern, Paladinen und ihrem alten Geliebten?! description.en:
Catherine Panya thought she could live a happy life after leaving her terrible family. She was lucky enough to find a huge manor for dirt cheap, but only because the land attracts demons! And the only one powerful enough to vanquish those demons is Grand Duke Chezare Christopher, the Great Sorcerer. Although the reason is unclear, he offers Catherine a key that can summon him whenever she needs him. Is this Catherine's literal key to happiness? Or will it unlock a door to even more trouble?
____
Catherine did not want much.

Even if she did not have luxurious clothes and shoes, she was alright with her hideously frayed bedroom curtains and her shoes that were so worn at the soles it was different in height.

It had been two years since she started enduring it for the sake of her late mother.

She no longer felt the need to do that.

"Alright, I'll leave."

Catherine was tired of everything.

====

"Are you the Pope's watchdog? You've done well coming all the way here."

The man who intruded her home was drenched from head to toe.
She could see mud squished beneath his black leather boots.

Unbelievable.
To think he would drag in not grass, but mud, while she was cleaning the floors!

"You've got quite the disguise. Even I was almost fooled into thinking that you're just an ordinary city woman---"
"Wipe it."

She pushed the rag she held onto the man.

"Why are you looking at me so foolishly? I told you to wipe the floor. And it's not proper to show your sword when it's our first time meeting each other. Is it not enough that you intruded that you would want to be reported for attempted murder?"
description.ko:
캐서린은 많은 걸 원하지 않았다.

옷과 장신구 같은 사치품이 없어도,
끝이 다 찢겨 흉측한 침실의 커튼이나
굽이 다 닳아 높이가 다른 구두도 괜찮았다.

돌아가신 어머니를 위해서라도
이를 악물고 견딘지 2년.

이제 더는 그럴 필요를 느끼지 못했다.

"좋아요, 제가 나갈게요."

캐서린은이 모든 것에 지쳤다.

===

"교황의 번견인가? 여기까지 잘도 찾아왔군."

그녀의 저택에 침입한 남자는 머리부터 발끝까지 젖은 채였다.
까만 가죽 장화 아래로 진흙이 엉망으로 뭉개진 게 보였다.

“뭘 그렇게 멍청하게 봐? 바닥 닦으라니까? 그리고 초면에 함부로 검 들이미는 거 아니야. 주거 침입으로 모자라 살인 미수로 신고당하고 싶어?”
description.pl:
Catherine nie chciała wiele. Nawet jeśli nie miała luksusowych ubrań i butów, odpowiadały jej ohydnie postrzępione zasłony w sypialni i szpilki, które były tak zużyte na podeszwach, że różniły się wysokością od zwykłych butów. Minęły dwa lata, odkąd zaczęła to znosić ze względu na swoją zmarłą matkę. Teraz nie czuła już takiej potrzeby. 
"W porządku, odejdę." 
Catherine była zmęczona wszystkim. 
*** 
Jesteś strażniczką papieża? Dobrze zrobiłaś, że tu przybyłaś". 
Mężczyzna, który wtargnął do jej domu, był przemoczony od stóp do głów. Pod jego czarnymi skórzanymi butami widać było błoto. 
Niewiarygodne. 
Pomyśleć, że wlókł nie trawę, ale błoto, podczas gdy ona czyściła podłogi! 
"Masz niezłe przebranie. Nawet ja dałem się nabrać, że jesteś zwykłą kobietą z miasta..." 
"Wytrzyj to." 
Pchnęła szmatę, którą trzymała, na mężczyznę. 
"Dlaczego patrzysz na mnie tak głupio? Kazałam ci wytrzeć podłogę. I nie wypada pokazywać miecza, gdy spotykamy się po raz pierwszy. Czy nie wystarczy już, że tu wtargnąłeś, że chcesz być jeszcze zgłoszony za usiłowanie zabójstwa?

description.en: Nam Joo Won is a high school teacher with a phobia of students. On the first day of classes, Joo Won runs to the faculty bathroom to find shelter from his students but encounters the class delinquent, Lee Tae Gyum. Why won't this kid leave him alone?

When he was a child, his father was said to have died from a car accident. But what actually caused his death was ‘Medical Negligence’.
Ever since that, his dream was to become a ‘Perfect Doctor’ that would never deny or mistreat a patient.

However, reality was harsh.
His mother was inflicted with an incurable disease, which required a lot of money. He quit his university hospital internship and became a sell-out dermatologist.

While he had stopped in his tracks due to the harshness of reality, a state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence, ‘A.I. – Ronnie’, came to him.
And thus, his journey to become a perfect doctor started once again.

Now, Rotieh must clear her name and restore her lost wealth, but that's easier said than done when she doesn't wanna work!

Born as a genius among geniuses in Herbal Medicine, I've undergone countless reincarnations, all at the request of the Gods! I can't stop until I create the perfect Divine Elixir...

Isn’t this a scam? In the end, in this current life, I declared a strike.

I’m not going to do it! No, I won’t work!!!

"I'm counting on you."
"Me? Are you serious?!"
Surprisingly, my strained family relationships seem to be improving.

"Thank you so much!"
I'm receiving expressions of gratitude from all over the place. And to top it off…

"A long-lost disciple came to see you."
My first, and also my last, disciple appeared in front of me.

Why didn’t he die?
description.fr:
Née en tant qu'herboriste de génie, les dieux lui ont fait la promesse de faire d'elle l'une des leurs si elle répondait à leur exigence de créer la boisson divine parfaite.

Là voilà donc vivre des tas de vies en tant que femme, homme, enfant et même sirène et ogre ! Mais rien n'y fait les dieux restent insatisfaits. Pour elle c'en est trop! Fini de travailler!
description.id: Aku, Lottie Pione, menyatakan mogok dengan ayah! Saya tidak akan bekerja! *** Ia terlahir sebagai seorang jenius dalam pengobatan herbal. Jika dewa membuat Nektar, itu membuatnya menjadi dewa. Aku berulang kali bereinkarnasi dalam reinkarnasiku, berpikir bahwa salah satu keturunanku akan keluar sepertiku "Kenapa tidak semua orang bisa melakukan ini...?" Aku sangat baik sehingga tidak ada yang bisa melompatiku. Aku telah hidup kali seperti itu. Aku menyatakan mogok. Aku tidak bisa melakukannya! Tidak, aku tidak bekerja! Itu pasti seperti itu "Aku mengandalkan mu." "Baru! Baru!" “Akulah yang canggung.” Kupikir lebih baik memiliki hubungan keluarga yang tidak berperasaan "Kenyal! Terima kasih." Terima kasih atas bantuan Anda. Aku mendapat terima kasih dari semua jenis intelektual dan roh. "Aku sudah lama tidak bertemu guruku." Hidangan pertama dan terakhirku muncul. Kenapa dia tidak mati?
description.ko: 약초학의 천재 중의 천재로 태어났다. 신의 요구를 들어주면 나도 신으로 만들어준대서, nn번이나 환생을 거듭했는데! 완벽한 신의 음료를 만들 때까지 그만둘 수 없다니... 이건 사기 계약이야. 결국 나는 이번 생에, 파업을 선언했다. 나 못 해! 아니, 일 안 해!!! 분명 그랬는데. “나는 너에게 기대를 걸고 있단다.” “뉴, 뉴냐!!” 삭막한 가족 관계가 좋아지질 않나. “취익! 고, 맙다.” <…도와줘서 고마워.> 여기저기서 감사 인사를 받지 않나. 거기다. “불초한 제자가 오랜만에 스승님을 뵈어요.” 내 첫 번째 제자이자 마지막 제자 놈까지 나타났다. 저놈 왜 안 죽었지?

description.en:
Andert the Hero. A great swordsman who ended the great war by sacrificing himself. One of the greatest heroes of all time.

…But in truth, I was a woman disguised as a man, living under the identity of my dead younger brother. That was me.

And then—

“Huh?”

I came back to life… four years after dying?

With nothing but this body left, there was only one way to survive.

A maid.

“Which kind of household would you like to work in?” “A place so harsh and awful that even if one of two workers dies, no one would notice.” “And what kind of employer are you looking for?” “A vicious employer who squeezes their workers dry.”

That way, I’ll be the only one willing to work there—and they won’t be able to fire me.

“……”

The interviewer looked at me like I was completely insane.

Still, it doesn’t matter.

Here, I’ll start over.

Not as the hero Andert. Not as my dead younger brother.

But as a maid— Daisy.

description.en:
Possessed as the daughter of male lead´s stepmother in an impoverished BL novel. To the time when the young male lead was neglected in abuse.

If the lead succeeds in escaping like the original, *he* will come to kill me, but what should I do? In order to live, I took care of the male lead and treated him, and he shyly said.

“I feel like there is someone I like.”

His cheeks turned rosy like peaches. But *he* couldn't easily say who *he* liked. Of course, how can you say that easily!

"Its okay! No matter who you like, your taste matters!”

So, my child, do whatever you want! I will respect your taste!

===

“…Edwin?”

Now, he shed tears as he grabbed me as I was about to leave. Then he threatens me with eyes that shimmer with obsession.

“If you want to leave me, kill me and leave, Alice.”

…How are you supposed to kill the strongest person in the world? He suddenly turned black and won't let me go.
___
Young Alice Estevan has a secret. She was actually reborn in *The Tyrant's Silver Flower*, a hardcore, tragic BL where she'll be killed for abusing the male leads! Luckily, she still has time to avoid that fate by liberating Edwin, one of the male leads, from the tower he's trapped in. And though she succeeds in getting the key to free the boy, there's just one problem: he hates her guts! With the threat of death looming ever so closer, will Alice win Edwin over and earn her happy ending?
description.fr: Quand elle se réincarne dans son roman de Boy's Love préféré, Alice est aux anges... avant de se rappeler que son personnage est censé se faire tuer par un des deux héros ! Alors pour éviter cette fin tragique et pour pouvoir observer à loisir son couple préféré, il va falloir porter secours à Edwin!
description.id: Aku bereinkarnasi ke dalam sebuah novel BL tragedy berjudul ‘The Tyrant's Silver Flower’ sebagai saudara tiri pemeran utama. Itu juga tepat sebelum per temuan tokoh utama berlangsung. Tidak ada yang bisa aku lakukan, Sangat disayangkan aku harus melihat mereka berdua di sini... "Tunggu! Kenapa aku harus reinkarnasi ke tubuh ini?!" Aku mencoba untuk menghindari akhir dari wanita jahat yang dibunuh oleh pameran utama saat pertama bertemu aku akan mendukung cinta mereka , tapi entah bagaimana tiran obsesif paling gila yang pernah ada ,berusaha mendapatkan cinta dariku. 그것도 두 주인공의 역사적인 거사가 이루어지기 직전에. 

별 수 있나, 아쉬운 대로
여기서 둘이 꽁냥거리는 모습이라도 봐야…
‘잠깐! 왜 하필 얘한테 빙의한 거야?’

남주에게 가장 먼저 죽임 당하는 악녀 엔딩을 피하고
마음 편히 두 사람의 사랑을 응원하려고 했는데,
역대 최강 집착광공이 어째서인지 한 마리 순한 양이 되어
나한테 예쁨 받으려고 한다.  

‘…앨리스, 나도 예뻐?’
description.pl:
Odrodziłam się jako córka macochy bohatera zubożałej powieści BL.

Do czasu gdy młody bohater był zaniedbywany i znęcany.

Jeśli tak to dalej pójdzie, po jego ucieczce wróci tu by mnie zabić! Co robić?!

Aby przeżyć, pilnowałam i leczyłam go, a on nieśmiało powiedział mi:

"Czuję, że jest ktoś kogo lubię"

Jego policzki zrobiły się różowe jak brzoskwinie. Pewnie nie łatwo było mu to powiedzieć. Oczywiście, komu przyszłoby to łatwo!

"W porządku! Bez względu na to kogo lubisz, będe szanować twoje preferencje!"

Moje dziecko, rób co chcesz! Uszanuję twój gust!

====

"...Edwin?"

Roniąc łzy chwycił mnie, gdy miałam już wychodzić. Potem spojrzał na mnie oczami błyszczącymi groźnie.

"Jeżeli zamierzasz mnie opuścić, zabij mnie i odejdź, Alice"

...Jak miałabym zabić najsilniejszą osobę na świecie?

Nagle bohater się zmienił i nie chciał pozwolić mi odejść.
____
Młoda Alice Estevan skrywa pewien sekret. W rzeczywistości odrodziła się w *The Tyrant's Silver Flower*, hardkorowym, tragicznym BL, w którym zostanie zabita za znęcanie się nad głównymi bohaterami! Na szczęście wciąż ma czas, aby uniknąć tego losu, uwalniając Edwina, jednego z głównych bohaterów, z wieży, w której jest uwięziony. I choć udaje jej się zdobyć klucz do uwolnienia chłopca, jest tylko jeden problem: on jej nienawidzi! Czy Alice uda się przekonać Edwina i zasłużyć na szczęśliwe zakończenie?
description.ru:
Каким-то образом меня затянуло в роман «Серебряный цветок тирана» жанра яой. Всё случилось незадолго до переломного момента между главными персонажами.

Но, к сожалению, я только вижу, как они спорят, и ничего не могу с этим поделать... «Минуточку! Как же тогда эти двое в итоге влюбились в друг друга?»

Моя главная цель – не стать злодейкой, убитой главным героем. Поэтому я должна помочь этим двоим в их любви. Но, по какой-то причине, самый сильный и помешанный герой всех времен стал нежной овечкой и ведёт себя так, будто хочет угодить мне.

«Алиса... Ты тоже считаешь меня красивым?»
description.sk: Mladá Alice Estevan má tajomstvo. Prevtelila sa do BL novely s názvom „Tyranov strieborný kvet“, kde má byť jej postava zavraždená, pretože týra hlavných hrdinov! Našťastie má čas k tomu, aby sa vyhla takému osudu tým, že bude Edwina, jedného z hlavných protagonistov, učiť vo veži, v ktorej je uväznený. A hoci uspeje pri získaní kľúča, aby chlapca oslobodila, má to jeden háčik: Edwin ju nenávidí! Dokáže si Alice Edwina získať na svoju stranu, aby sa vyhla tomu, že by ju zabil a ona tak mohla dosiahnuť svoj šťastný koniec?

Amelie Bourbon was a witch and a woman killed by the tyrant.

Just because I criticized a novel doesn't mean you have to make me into the supporting character Amelie, who died from the start, becoming the trauma and trigger of the heroine.

I'm scared. I don't want to die. I don't want to be harassed.

Let's run away!

But just when Amelie visited her family to inform them of her departure, the Emperor (the tyrant) arrived. In order to escape, I transformed into a bird by magic.

But the Emperor took me with him!!!

What's going to happen to me?!

---
Amelie Bourbon is a witch, destined to die at the hands of her lover, the ruthless tyrant Serwin Hennessia. So when ordinary office worker Lee Suyeon is reborn as Amelie, she vows to change the ill-fated story. The problem is the “calamity” sealed inside Serwin’s body, which threatens to ruin him and the entire world, can only be calmed when he is near Amelie. As she grows closer to Serwin, Amelie must hone her magic to subdue his violent impulses, but can she defeat calamity once and for all?

I only went to calm the disturbance in front of my house, but the one I encountered was the Demon King that I punished, and unfortunately, I was falsely accused of being the demon king and died in the hand of the subjugation team.

‘I’ll kick your ass, Pamel Asinov! I’ll make you shed tears from both of your eyes!’

Among them, the worst one was the hero, Pamel Asinov, who drove me to death as a Demon King!

But when I pleaded to take revenge, I opened my eyes, 500 years later! Pamel’s been dead for a long time, and the ‘brothers’ who came one day…

“Purple eyes. It’s not a color that anyone can have.”
“But I was like this from the beginning.”
“Yes, you were. Because you are the granddaughter of Archduke Asinov.”
“…the granddaughter of Archduke Asinov?”

Of all people, I’m the daughter of ‘that’ Asinov? It’s nice to live a peaceful life, but I was born an enemy’s blood!

‘All the brothers in this house have a habit of hugging people.’

This shitty family. I have to hate them, but why do I keep getting attached to them?
description.ko:
집 앞에서 벌어진 소란을 잠재우러 갔을 뿐인데
내가 응징한 건 마왕이었고,
운 나쁘게도 내가 마왕이라는 누명을 쓰는 바람에 토벌단에게 죽고 말았다. 

‘혼쭐을 내 주마, 파멜 아시노프! 두 눈에서 눈물을 펑펑 흘리게 해 주지!’

그 중에서도 제일 나쁜 놈은
나를 마왕으로 몰아 죽인 영웅 파멜 아시노프!

하지만 복수를 다짐한 게 무색하게도 눈을 뜨니, 500년 후! 
이미 파멜은 죽은 지 오래인데다, 어느 날 찾아온 ‘오빠들'은....

“보라색 눈동자. 그건 아무나 가질 수 있는 색이 아닙니다.”
“하지만 전 처음부터 이랬어요.”
“그렇겠지요. 당신은 아시노프 대공의 손녀니까요.”
“...아시노프 대공의 손녀요?”

하필이면 내가 ‘그’ 아시노프의 딸이라고?
평온한 삶인 건 좋은데 원수의 핏줄로 태어나버렸다!

‘이 집 형제들은 전부 사람을 덥석덥석 안아드는 습관이 있네.’

이놈의 집구석. 미워해야 하는데 어째서 자꾸만 정이 드는거지?!
description.pl: Poszłam tylko uspokoić zamieszanie przed moim domem, ale ten, którego spotkałam, był królem demonów, którego ukarałam, i niestety zostałam fałszywie oskarżona o bycie królową demonów i zginęłam z ręki zespołu podporządkowania. "Skopię ci tyłek, Pamel Asinov! Sprawię, że będziesz ronić łzy z obu oczu!" Wśród nich najgorszy był bohater, Pamel Asinov, który doprowadził mnie do śmierci jako Król Demonów! Ale kiedy błagałam o zemstę, otworzyłam oczy, 500 lat później! Pamel nie żyje od dawna, a „bracia”, którzy przybyli pewnego dnia... "Fioletowe oczy. To nie jest kolor, który każdy może mieć." „Ale ja byłam taka od początku.” "Tak, byłaś. Ponieważ jesteś wnuczką arcyksięcia Asinova". „...wnuczką arcyksięcia Asinowa?” Jestem córką „tego” Asinowa? Miło jest wieść spokojne życie, ale urodziłam się w krwi wroga! „Wszyscy bracia w tym domu mają zwyczaj przytulania ludzi”. Ta gówniana rodzina. Muszę ich nienawidzić, ale dlaczego wciąż się do nich przywiązuję?

And, above all, the emperor, who was the supposed villain, was very kind and protective of her. But, she just wanted to cook in peace!

description.ko:
미쳐버린 요정의 딸, 리체시아.
사람 잡아먹는 꽃을 키우며,
마음에 들지 않는 상대는 도끼로 찍어 버리는
잔인한 성격으로 유명한 요녀.

“와, 미띠겟네.”

온갖 화려한 사건 사고의 중심이었던 그녀가…….

“또라부리겟네.”

아기로 살게 되었다!

미친 요정의 피를 이은 리체시아는
죽은 엄마를 실험한 자들을 찾기 위해
직접 아기로 변신하여 바실리안가의 입양아가 되었다.

“쩨샤 바실리안입니당.”

정보만 빼내고 도망칠 생각이었건만
어째 돌아가는 상황이 이상하다.
얼굴만 멀쩡하고, 죄다 제정신이 아닌 바실리안가의 남자들은
체샤에게 점차 과한 관심과 흥미를 가지기 시작하는데.

“침실에 갔는데 체샤가 없어서 놀랐어. 누가 체샤를 뺏어 간 줄 알고.”

아름답지만 위험한 아빠와

“왜 백작가에 남고 싶다고 청하지 않지?”
“너는 진짜 이상해. 너 때문에 나도 이상해졌어.”

어디로 튈지 모르는 정신 나간 삼 형제들은
입양아를 향한 애정이 점점 커져만 가고.

심지어 오랫동안 요녀를 쫓아왔던
신성 제국의 이단 심문관 또한 상태가 이상하다.
그는 체샤를 요녀의 딸이라고 오해하고
있지도 않은 친아버지를 찾아댄다.

“아부디는 왜 찾으새요……?”
“죽여버려야지.”

귀찮게 들러붙는 놈들 때문에 피곤한 와중.
체샤는 자신이 어른의 몸으로 되돌아가지 못한다는 사실을 알게 된다.
심지어 요녀를 추적하는 포위망까지 점점 좁혀오기 시작하는데…….

“날 어디까지 망가뜨릴 생각이지, 요녀?”

체샤는 과연 무사히 백작가에서 탈출할 수 있을까?
description.ru:
Ричезия — дочь безумной феи, а также злодейка-чародейка, известная своим жестоким нравом, которая выращивает цветы, пожирающие людей, а неугодных просто четвертует топором ради забавы.

«Вау, с ума сойти!»

Однако теперь эта главная фигура самых громких скандалов...

«Просто слов нет.»

Вынуждена жить как ребёнок!

Она намеревается отыскать тех, кто проводил опыты над её покойной мамой, из-за чего оборачивается маленькой девочкой и становится удочерённой родом Базилиан.

«Отныне я Чеза Базилиан.»

Девушка собиралась только разузнать важные для себя сведения, но всё идёт совершенно не по плану: одержимые мужчины семьи Базилиан, что лишь с виду кажутся благородными, начинают проявлять к ней чрезмерный интерес...

«Решил проведать нашу Чезу в покоях, но, никого там не обнаружив, не на шутку перепугался, считая, что её похитили.»

Среди которых был красивый, но опасный приёмный отец...

«Почему бы тебе не остаться в графском поместье?»

«Ты действительно странная, и я теперь тоже стал таким.»

И трое помешанных, непредсказуемых братьев, чья любовь к новой сестрёнке неимоверно росла день ото дня.

Даже сам инквизитор Священной Империи, долго охотившийся на на наследницу крови безумной феи, внезапно начинает вести себя странно. Он ошибочно принимает Чезу за дочь Ричезии, из-за чего приступает к поискам её несуществующего родного отца.

«Зачем Вам мой папа?»

«Хочу убить его.»

Устав от всех этих надоед, дама вскоре понимает, что не в состоянии вернуться в свой взрослый облик. Вдобавок охотники, преследующие чародейку ещё с юных лет, начинают наступать ей на пятки...

«Насколько сильно ты желаешь растоптать меня и замучить, злая чародейка?»

Сможет ли она в итоге благополучно сбежать из дома Базилиан?

No entanto, os homens excêntricos da família se apegam excessivamente a ela, complicando seus planos. Enquanto luta para escapar, descobre que não pode retornar à sua forma adulta, e seus inimigos se aproximam.

description.en:
I thought he died from overwork in Korea, but when I opened my eyes, I found that I was a supporting character in a novel I wrote. As Evangeline who was executed for harassing the female lead.

While running and running alone to avoid the ending of the original, she said, “I copied the author’s novel when I was creating the world. Instead, if there is anything you want, I will give it to you.”

---
After the last episode "Servant Yesterday, Crown Princess Today," the author thought she was done with the story. But when she awakens as the villainess, Evangeline, she realizes the ending was just the beginning! To avoid the gruesome end she originally wrote for Evangeline, she resolves to win the male lead's favor and be accepted into his household. But as the plot begins to take strange turns that make Evangeline the new heroine, it becomes clear this story was written by someone else...
description.fr: Autrice passionnée, Mme Kim s’épuise à la tâche et finit par tomber inconsciente… pour se réveiller au cœur du roman qu’elle a écrit. Elle se réincarne alors dans la peau d’Evangéline, un personnage secondaire, et pense être parée à toute éventualité, car ce monde est le produit de son imagination et elle en connaît tous les rouages. Pourtant, tout semble aller de travers et les évènements paraissent de plus en plus s’éloigner de l’intrigue de son propre roman...
description.id: Suatu hari, aku terbangun di dalam tubuh Evangeline, tokoh antagonis dalam web novel yang kutulis. Aku harus berusaha mengubah nasib agar aku tidak dihukum mati seperti Evangeline di dalam cerita karanganku. Aku tidak ingin kehidupan yang abadi, aku tidak ingin menjadi kesatria, yang aku inginkan hanyalah menjadi alkemis! Tunggu saja, 'si jahat' Evangeline ini akan menjadi alkemis terhebat di seluruh kekaisaran!

description.pl: Kiedy otworzyłam oczy, okazało się, że stałam się aktorem drugoplanowym w napisanej przez siebie powieści. Evangeline, która została stracona za molestowanie bohaterki. Podczas biegu i samotnego biegu, aby uniknąć początkowego końca, "Kiedy stworzyłam świat, skopiowałam powieść autorki. Zamiast tego, jeśli jest coś, czego chcesz, dam ci to". Niech Bóg cię błogosławi za zaproszenie mnie tutaj Uroda, zdolności, siła finansowa i pochodzenie zostały całkowicie zapomniane. Teraz pozostaje mi tylko czekać na szczęśliwe zakończenie. "Bo ona będzie moją towarzyszką". Próbowałam dogadać się z rzeźbiarsko wyglądającym najstarszym synem księcia, vel chłopcem Kaidla, "Evangeline będzie moją córką i będziemy żyć razem na zawsze". Nie było to łatwe, ponieważ książę uniemożliwił jej przyjęcie jej jako rodzinnego skarbu. nie są! Mój wniosek powinien brzmieć: "Żyłam długo i szczęśliwie"!
description.ru: «Эванджелин? Она только что назвала меня Эванджелин?..» Я, будучи на протяжении многих лет никому не известным писателем, очнулась в теле злодейки из собственного дебютного романа - Эванджелин, пытавшейся убить главную героиню при помощи своей смертоносной красоты. Если всё произойдёт в соответствии с оригинальной историей, меня ждёт смерть! Нужно как-то избежать этой трагедии! Я ненавижу вечную жизнь, рыцарей и святых. Всё, чего я хочу, - это стать алхимиком. Просто подождите, и я покажу вам, как злодейка Эванджелин станет сильнейшим алхимиком Империи!
description.es-la: Cuando abrí los ojos, me encontré convirtiéndome en un actor secundario en una novela que había escrito. Evangeline, quien fue ejecutada por acosar a la heroína. Mientras corría y corría solo para evitar el final inicial, “Cuando creé el mundo, copié la novela del autor. En cambio, si hay algo que quieras, te lo daré”. Dios los bendiga por invitarme aquí La belleza, la capacidad, la fortaleza financiera y los antecedentes están completamente olvidados. Ahora todo lo que tengo que hacer es esperar un final feliz. “Porque ella será mi compañera”. Traté de llevarme bien con el hijo mayor del duque de aspecto escultural, también conocido como Kaidel boy, "Evangeline será mi hija y viviremos juntos para siempre". No fue fácil porque el duque le impidió aceptarla como un tesoro familiar. ¡no son! ¡Mi conclusión debería ser “Viví feliz para siempre”!
description.pt-br: Achei que tinha morrido por cansaço na Coréia, mas acordei dentro de uma novel que eu lia em minha vida antiga, como Angeline, personagem que maltratava a protagonista e é executada. Por isso, agora eu tenho que fazer de tudo para sobreviver.

description.en:
Life is all about taking the easy way for Seokwoo, who feels zero guilt over robbing thousands of players as Luke in the VR game, Argus. 

Just when he's leveled up to a master criminal, however, he gets caught and is sentenced to life in prison! Luckily, Luke discovers the will of the vanquished Night King in his cell, which lets him start the game over in exchange for getting revenge on the king's enemies. 

Though his level and stats have been reset, it's only a matter of time before Argus' infamous thief steals his way back to the top!

"Would you like to live once again?" 

It was a peaceful and normal life an average person would live. Getting a job, meeting ‘the one’ and getting married, then living life with your own loving family. I was living that life. 

Then I got an offer to start life again.

 The excitement of starting life once again quickly faded away. Faced with the fading memories of my past life, growing fainter and fainter as each day passed by; the fear of not being able to meet my wife and daughter overwhelmed me. To make matters worse, the opportunity to become an actor, a dream that I had given up before, was tempting… 

"If I live this life differently from my previous one, there’s a chance that I might not be able to meet my wife and daughter!"

Stuck between family and the dream I had given up, what will be my choice?

description.en: Ah-ju lives two lives, a university student and an exclusive maid for the emperor. When she sleeps in one world, she wakes up in another. One day, the emperor asks her, "Help me with my love!"

I reincarnated as the lowest-ranked support character in a game. Being born as the great duke's daughter wouldn't have been so bad, if… my fate hadn't been to be murdered by him on my 9th birthday! Seriously, what kind of destiny is that?!   
  
Fine then! If I can't avoid my fate, then I'll have to conquer it!  
"Time to become friend with the main character and knock out the Demon King!"  
Follow the heroine as she embarks on a great adventure to overcome her terrible fate and defeat the Demon King while she's at it!  
  
*This is a promotional webtoon for the novel of the same name.*

By a turn of events, Jin Naye ended up kissing her co-worker’s boyfriend, not to mention she keeps hearing a maleficent voice which nobody else can hear…  
  
At home, she’s a pitiful daughter who didn’t even get married yet, and at work she’s a weak-willed pushover. Day by day, Naye is forced to live a life full of torment. In order to defy her mother’s wish to meet a marriage prospect on her own birthday, she attends a party and gets herself some drinks - actions which are unlike her. There, she ended up having her first kiss, but with her co-worker’s boyfriend?! From that day onward, Naye’s life started to change bit by bit…
